🎥🎬: Vision Quest (1985)

Louden Swain is an ambitious high school wrestler determined to prove himself by dropping down a weight class to challenge the toughest opponent in his division. At 18, he believes that defeating the reigning champion will be the ultimate test of his discipline, strength, and determination. But the closer he gets to his goal, the more he realizes that the real battle may be against himself.

As Louden pushes his body through punishing training sessions, he meets Carla, an older drifter who comes into his life and challenges the way he sees the world. Their growing connection forces him to balance his emotions with the sacrifices required to achieve his wrestling dream.

With his championship match approaching, Louden must discover whether he has the mental toughness to overcome exhaustion, doubt, and temptation. Vision Quest is an inspiring story about ambition, sacrifice, and the determination to prove that you’re capable of more than anyone expects.

source_details.synopsis: Vision Quest (released in the United Kingdom and Australia as Crazy for You) is a 1985 American coming-of-age romantic drama/sports film starring Matthew Modine, Michael Schoeffling, Ronny Cox and Linda Fiorentino in her first film role. It is based on Terry Davis's 1979 novel of the same name. Modine plays a Spokane high school wrestler who falls in love with an older woman, an aspiring artist from Trenton, New Jersey, on her way to San Francisco. The film includes the first major motion picture appearance by Madonna, who plays a singer at a local bar, where she performs the songs "Crazy for You" and "Gambler".
